fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2017, for every one cent increase in the cost of a gallon of jet fuel, our fuel expense would increase by approximately $2.5 million, excluding the results of our fuel hedge program.

instrument_type_details.notes: Heating oil swaps and crude oil call options. Not designated as ASC 815 hedges. FV net asset $15.09M at Dec 31 2016 (crude oil call options $8.489M + heating oil swaps $6.601M). Derivative position table shows combined notional of 17,850 thousand gallons (= 17.85M gallons) settling December 2017. Item7a states 50% of projected 2017 fuel requirements hedged. Volume/percentage discrepancy likely because crude oil call options are measured in barrel-equivalent exposure, not straight gallons.
